newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PORTUGUESE SHARES RECOUP SOME LOSSES ON U.S. DATA.
newsitem.headline: PORTUGUESE SHARES RECOUP SOME LOSSES ON U.S. DATA.

text.p: 1310 GMT - Shares were recovering some early losses after U.S. producer price and retail sales data were seen as postponing any increase in interest rates there.
*Traders noted that the PPI and sales figures had also triggered rallies elsewhere in Europe.
*U.S. retail sales rose 0.6 percent, below expectations, while the PPI fell 0.1 percent.
*The PSI-20 stock index was down 39 percent with the trend during the afternoon dependent on New York, traders said.
